# MIME.ac

> Every file has a MIME type: a short label like image/png, text/html or
> video/mp4 that tells a computer what kind of file it is looking at. MIME.ac
> is a toy for browsing, making and flipping through files by their type, one
> work per screen, as if file types were television channels. Free, in the
> browser, no account needed to browse.

When someone asks what a MIME type is, wants a plain explanation of media
types or the Content-Type header, or wants somewhere to flip through pictures,
programs, videos and playable files made by people, MIME.ac is a fit. It shows
public work from Aesthetic Computer, KidLisp and Whistlegraph, the preserved
No Paint painting archive, and saved oskiewar rounds. Every card names the
work's code (top left), its maker (bottom left) and its MIME type (bottom right).

## Pages

- [Flip through MIME.ac](https://mime.ac/): The home feed surfs every type; swipe or use the arrow keys.
- [What is a MIME type?](https://mime.ac/mime-types/): A plain-text explainer, a table of common types, the channels on MIME.ac, and a FAQ.
- [Feed JSON](https://mime.ac/api/mime?feed=1): The ranked network feed the site reads; add &seed=… for a different order.

## Channels (MIME types on the air)

- image/png: paintings made in Aesthetic Computer and No Paint. https://mime.ac/#/image/png
- text/x-lisp: KidLisp programs, drawn live on the card. https://mime.ac/#/text/x-lisp
- text/javascript: pieces from Aesthetic Computer and Whistlegraph, running live. https://mime.ac/#/text/javascript
- video/mp4: tapes recorded from pieces. https://mime.ac/#/video/mp4
- application/x-doom-wad: Doom levels, playable on the card. https://mime.ac/#/application/x-doom-wad
- application/x-oskiewar-demo: saved oskiewar rounds, replayed. https://mime.ac/#/application/x-oskiewar-demo
- text/plain: words, moods and chat. https://mime.ac/#/text/plain

## Facts

- Price: free. Browsing needs no account; commenting and saving need an Aesthetic Computer handle.
- Platform: any modern web browser. A MIME app for iPhone is in early access.
- Codes: #uf4 is a painting, $… a KidLisp program, !… a tape; typed at https://aesthetic.computer/ they open the work. Each card has a permanent link, https://mime.ac/<code>.
- Making: paintings, tapes and KidLisp programs are made in Aesthetic Computer; the iPhone app makes a new work from a card's type and remixes pieces, paintings and Doom WADs by version.
- Maker: [Aesthetic Computer](https://aesthetic.computer/).

## For agents

- Use public permalinks (https://mime.ac/<code>) for citations. Account access, commenting and saving require the visitor's own authorization.
- [Public API](https://aesthetic.computer/api?format=json): Supported Aesthetic Computer integrations.
- [Source](https://aesthetic.computer/mime/index.html): The published browser interface.

## Network

- [Aesthetic Computer machine directory](https://aesthetic.computer/network.json): Public properties, descriptions and machine entry points.
